description: This file defines a Java interface 'Attribute' for the OpenMRS project, specifying a contract for user-defined attributes attached to various entities, with methods to get and set owner and attribute type.

classes.name: Attribute
classes.description: A generic interface representing a user-defined attribute associated with entities in OpenMRS, parameterized by AttributeType and owner type.

methods.name: getOwner
methods.description: Returns the owner of the attribute, which is of a generic type extending Customizable.

methods.name: setOwner
methods.description: Sets the owner of the attribute.

methods.name: getAttributeType
methods.description: Returns the AttributeType that defines the behavior and properties of this attribute.
